line.en: free outdoor market at aberdeen plaza in lansdowne park, part of the 27 to 29 nov weekend. gifts and food from the stalls.
line.de: freier open-air-markt am aberdeen plaza im lansdowne park, Teil des wochenendes 27. bis 29. nov. geschenke und essen von den ständen.
line.tr: lansdowne park'ta aberdeen plaza'da ücretsiz açık hava pazarı, 27–29 kasım haftasonunun bir parçası. stantlardan hediyeler ve yiyecekler.

sparks.why: Ottawa Christmas Market, free, Aberdeen Plaza at Lansdowne Park; the 27 to 29 Nov weekend per several listings (todocanada.ca; Park Indigo blog). Saturday hours of 10 to 22 come from one listing only, so 12:00 is a suggested start.
